metadata.description: Shawn Carrillo's Claude Code plugins: where-were-we prompt navigation, the pr-review-cycle skill, and release automation

plugins.name: where-were-we
plugins.description: Timestamps your prompts in the transcript, adds up/down prompt navigation to the footer, and recaps where your last session left off

plugins.name: pr-review-cycle
plugins.description: Drive the full GitHub PR review → resolve → watch loop: summarize the PR, prioritize feedback, resolve threads, then watch for new reviewer activity

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Release automation toolkit - semantic versioning, changelogs, decisions tracking, and TestFlight integration
